heroTitle: Mental health care that comes to you.
heroText: Compassionate, evidence-based psychiatric care by secure video for children, teens, adults and older adults anywhere in Florida. No commute, no waiting room.
whoTitle: Care for every stage of life

who.title: Adults
who.text: Anxiety, depression, mood, sleep, focus and stress, treated around your work and family schedule.

who.title: Children and teens
who.text: Thoughtful care for young people from age 6, with parents and guardians as partners.

who.title: Older adults
who.text: Patient, respectful care from the comfort of home, with help getting set up for video visits.

aboutText: Ada is a board-certified psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner licensed in Florida, with more than six years of experience across inpatient and outpatient care, including caring for active-duty service members. Patients describe her as warm, empowering and genuinely caring.
aboutQuote: You deserve care that listens first, explains clearly and fits the life you're actually living.
melissaTitle: Call any hour. Someone always answers.
melissaText: Our virtual assistant, Melissa, answers the practice line day and night in English and Spanish. She can take an appointment request or a message for the care team and help you find what you need. For a crisis, always call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
